status: Sandbox reference contracts, manually authored from owner requirements; no production currency or anonymity certification
credit_invariants: Issuer signature authorizes dummy issuance; holder signature authorizes each transfer and redemption.

Unspent provenance is single-use within one authority process; duplicate requests with identical currency/action/signer/id namespace and fingerprint return the prior receipt when authority time has not moved backwards.

Conflicting operation ids within the same currency/action/signer namespace, spent inputs, forged signatures, cross-kind claims, unsafe integers, expired inputs, and supply inflation must reject before monetary mutation.
For each currency kind, issued equals outstanding plus redeemed; expiry does not erase the accounting record.
47 issued dummy units cannot produce 50 redeemable units. No exchange rate or dollar-to-unit conversion is implied.
Rewards require separately designated advertising inputs and an advertising offer and claim, bound by offerHash and challenge.
evidenceHash is a commitment supplied by the recipient, not proof of viewing, humanity, or attention. Bots and colluding recipients can produce signed claims.
State is necessary for single-use provenance and idempotency. Restart, independent replicas and offline acceptance do not provide monetary finality.

Every mutating entry point observes a nondecreasing trusted authority timestamp, including rejected requests. Clock rollback rejects; observing later time may update the clock guard while leaving monetary state unchanged.
Advertising claim replay identifiers are scoped to recipient signer plus claim id; unrelated recipients may use the same local id.
subscription_invariants: Publisher messages verify publisher identity, channel and UTC month under hp2p.sandbox.subscription.publisher.v1.
Symmetric channels authenticate channel, epoch and message id as AEAD associated data. Every member knowing the key can author a group message.
Keys must rotate monthly and cannot repeat in the same channel instance. Rotation does not revoke a recipient's saved historical keys.
Negotiation window is inclusive from seven days before through seven days after the month boundary. This helper neither takes payment nor distributes keys.

Composed publisher subscriptions sign channel, epoch, message id and text before monthly encryption; opening verifies the configured publisher and matching inner/outer scope. Group key possession alone cannot impersonate the publisher. Unchanged authentic messages remain replayable.
privacy_limits: Pseudonymous signing keys and transaction provenance are linkable; this reference model is not an anonymous payment system.
No signatures-only solution to double spending, ordering, revocation or offline finality is claimed.
Transport state is bounded local cache/peer state; monetary accounting remains a separate stateful component.
No real funds, token issuance, wallet, financial account, settlement or production backend is connected.
economic_invariants: A pending signed proposal or IOU is not settled funds. A verified authority acceptance is required before counting monetary value or granting a paid entitlement.

An unfunded or failed optional superlike reduces to an ordinary like, without fabricating settled creator income or paid access. Self-controlled sender and creator keys cannot turn an unbacked promise into payout.

Advertising uses only separately designated credits in a closed campaign budget. Collected proofs bind campaign, action, recipient and amount; replay and concurrent claims cannot spend beyond accepted funding.
Subscription access requires verified settled funds scoped to recipient, channel and monthly epoch. Pending promises, forged receipt objects and transplanted settlement references must not unlock it.
Proof collection provides attributable confirmation of a defined action and recipient-directed value; it does not prove human attention, unique people or advertising effectiveness.
All settlement, budget and access records are local dummy-model state. No service or token is issued against live funds, and no financial integration is connected.
